results.title: Login page loads
results.pre: App running at localhost:5173; user signed out
results.steps: 1. Open http://localhost:5173
results.expected: Sign-in form with Email, Password, Sign in button and demo accounts is shown
results.actual: Sign-in form displayed with email, password and demo account shortcuts

results.title: Login with wrong password is rejected
results.steps:
1. Enter admin@clinic.com
2. Enter wrong password
3. Click Sign in
results.expected: Error message shown; user stays on login page
results.actual: Error shown: "Invalid email or password"

results.title: Login blocked when fields are empty
results.steps:
1. Clear Email and Password
2. Click Sign in
results.expected: Form is not submitted; required-field validation triggers
results.actual: Browser required-field validation blocked submission; still on login page

results.title: Admin logs in successfully
results.steps:
1. Enter admin email and password
2. Click Sign in
results.expected: Redirected to Dashboard with today's stats and sidebar menu
results.actual: Dashboard loaded with sidebar navigation

results.title: Logout returns to login page
results.steps: 1. Click Log out in the sidebar
results.expected: Session ends and login page is shown
results.actual: Logged out; login page displayed

results.title: API rejects requests without a token
results.steps: 1. Open http://localhost:4000/api/patients without logging in
results.expected: HTTP 401 with an error message; no patient data returned
results.actual: HTTP 401 — {"error":"Not authenticated"}

results.title: Patient list loads
results.steps: 1. Click Patients in the sidebar
results.expected: Table of patients with ID, phone, age/sex, last visit and balance due
results.actual: 15 rows shown on page 1 (15 patients)

results.title: Search patient by name
results.steps: 1. Type "Karthik" in the search box
results.expected: Only matching patients are listed
results.actual: 1 matching row(s): Karthik Subramani	P000006	9840066666	16 / M	23 Oct 2026	₹1,800.00

results.title: Search with no match shows empty state
results.steps: 1. Type a name that does not exist
results.expected: "No patients match your search" message
results.actual: Empty-state message displayed

results.title: Register patient without phone is blocked
results.steps:
1. Click + Add patient
2. Enter first name only
3. Click Register patient
results.expected: Form not submitted; Phone is a required field
results.actual: Required-field validation on Phone stopped submission; dialog still open

results.title: Register new patient with allergies
results.steps:
1. Fill name, phone, gender, DOB, blood group, allergies, medical history
2. Click Register patient
results.data: Ananya Test01259, 9801259123, F, 1994-05-12, B+, Allergy: Penicillin
results.expected: Toast "Patient P0000xx registered"; profile opens with red allergy alert
results.actual: Patient P000016 registered; profile opened (id 16) with allergy alert "Penicillin"

results.title: Edit patient details
results.steps:
1. Click Edit details
2. Change address
3. Save changes
4. Open Details tab
results.expected: Toast "Patient updated"; Details tab shows new address
results.actual: Patient updated; address shown in Details tab: yes

results.title: Select a tooth on the odontogram
results.pre: Logged in as dentist; patient profile open
results.steps:
1. Open the test patient
2. Click tooth 16 on the dental chart
results.expected: Side panel shows "Tooth 16", tooth name, Not charted and the finding form
results.actual: Tooth 16 panel opened with "Not charted" status and Record finding form

results.title: Surfaces field accepts only M O D B L I
results.steps: 1. Type "mxz1o" into Surfaces
results.expected: Field shows "MO" (upper-cased, invalid characters removed)
results.actual: Field value = "MO"

results.title: Record a caries finding on tooth 16
results.steps:
1. Finding = Caries
2. Notes = "Deep occlusal caries"
3. Click Record finding
results.expected: Toast "Tooth 16 updated"; tooth badge and history show Caries (MO)
results.actual: Tooth 16 updated; history entry "Caries (MO)" added

results.title: Add a planned treatment
results.steps:
1. Treatments tab → + Add treatment
2. Pick first procedure, tooth 16, surfaces MO
3. Status Planned → Save
results.expected: Toast "<procedure> added"; row appears with status planned and fee from price list
results.actual: Composite Filling added; row: Composite Filling Added 27 Oct 2026 16 MO Dr. Priya Raman planned ₹1,800.00 StartCompleteCancel

results.title: Mark treatment as completed
results.steps: 1. Click Complete on the treatment row
results.expected: Toast "Marked completed"; status badge = completed; "1 completed not yet invoiced" shown
results.actual: Composite Filling added | Marked completed; status completed, banner "1 completed not yet invoiced" shown

results.title: Allergy warning and quick-add in prescription
results.steps:
1. Prescriptions tab → + New prescription
2. Click "+ Ibuprofen 400 mg" quick-add
results.expected: Red "⚠ Allergies: Penicillin" warning shown; Ibuprofen row filled automatically
results.actual: Allergy warning shown: yes; medicine row = "Ibuprofen 400 mg"

results.title: Save prescription
results.steps:
1. Advice = "Soft diet for 24 hours"
2. Click Save prescription
results.expected: Toast "Prescription saved"; card listed with drug, dose and Print link
results.actual: Prescription saved; prescription card with Print link listed

results.title: Printable prescription view
results.steps: 1. Click Print → on the prescription
results.expected: A4 print layout with clinic header, patient, Rx items and dentist
results.actual: Print page shows clinic header, patient details, Ibuprofen 400 mg and advice

results.title: Appointment calendar loads
results.steps: 1. Click Appointments
results.expected: Week calendar with Today/‹/› navigation, dentist filter and + Book button
results.actual: Week view rendered with navigation and + Book button

results.title: Book an appointment
results.steps:
1. Click + Book
2. Search & pick test patient
3. Start = tomorrow 16:00, 30 min
4. Reason = "Filling review"
5. Click Book
results.expected: Toast "Appointment booked"; appointment shown on calendar
results.actual: Appointment booked; Ananya Test01259 shown on 2026-10-28 4:00 PM

results.title: Double-booking the same dentist is blocked
results.pre: Appointment exists tomorrow 16:00 for the dentist
results.steps:
1. + Book
2. Pick another patient (Karthik)
3. Same dentist, tomorrow 16:15
4. Click Book
results.expected: Error "This time slot overlaps another appointment for the same dentist"; not saved
results.actual: Error toast: "This time slot overlaps another appointment for the same dentist"; dialog stays open, nothing saved

results.title: Change appointment status to Confirmed
results.steps:
1. Close the dialog
2. Click the appointment on the calendar
3. Click Mark confirmed
results.expected: Toast "Marked confirmed"; status badge changes to confirmed
results.actual: Marked confirmed

results.title: New invoice picks up completed treatment and calculates totals
results.steps:
1. Open patient → Create invoice
2. Enter Discount 100 and Tax 18%
results.expected: Treatment pre-ticked; Total = (Subtotal − 100) × 1.18
results.actual: Subtotal ₹1,800.00, Total ₹2,006.00 (expected ₹2006.00)

results.title: Create invoice with partial payment
results.steps:
1. Payment amount = 500, method UPI, reference
2. Click Create invoice
results.expected: Invoice created; status partial; balance = total − 500
results.actual: Invoice INV-2026-00007 created; status partial, ₹500 UPI payment listed

results.title: Payment larger than balance is blocked
results.steps:
1. Click Record payment
2. Enter amount above balance
3. Click Save payment
results.expected: Validation blocks the payment; invoice unchanged
results.actual: Form validation blocked it (max = balance); API also rejects: HTTP 400 "Payment exceeds the balance due (1506.00)"

results.title: Record remaining payment marks invoice paid
results.steps:
1. Amount = full balance (pre-filled)
2. Method Cash
3. Save payment
results.expected: Toast "Payment recorded"; status paid; balance ₹0.00
results.actual: Payment recorded; status paid, balance due ₹0.00

results.title: Download invoice PDF
results.steps: 1. Click Download PDF (checked via API)
results.expected: Server returns a PDF document (application/pdf)
results.actual: HTTP 200, application/pdf, 2457 bytes (saved as sample-invoice.pdf)

results.title: Add inventory item
results.steps:
1. Click + Add item
2. Fill name, SKU, category, unit, opening stock 10, reorder 5, cost
3. Save
results.data: Nitrile gloves (M) – test, UT-01259, 10 box, reorder 5, ₹450
results.expected: Toast "Item added"; item listed with 10 box in stock
results.actual: Item added; row: Nitrile gloves (M) – test UT-01259 Consumables 10 box 5 ₹450.00 — Stock in Use Edit

results.title: Record stock usage triggers low-stock alert
results.pre: Item has 10 in stock, reorder level 5
results.steps:
1. Click Use
2. Quantity = 6, Used for = "Clinic use"
3. Save
results.expected: Stock drops to 4 and a "low" badge appears
results.actual: Row after usage: Nitrile gloves (M) – test UT-01259 Consumables 4 box low 5 ₹450.00 — Stock in Use Edit

results.title: Using more stock than available is rejected
results.steps:
1. Click Use
2. Quantity = 50
3. Save
results.expected: Error message; stock unchanged at 4
results.actual: Form validation blocked it (max = 4 in stock); API also rejects: HTTP 400 "Not enough stock. Only 4 box available."; stock still 4

results.title: Low-stock filter
results.steps:
1. Clear search
2. Tick "Low stock only"
results.expected: Only items at or below reorder level are shown
results.actual: 8 item(s) shown, all flagged low / out of stock

results.title: Receptionist cannot open Staff page
results.steps: 1. Go to /staff directly
results.expected: "You don't have access to this page."
results.actual: Access-denied message shown

results.title: Dentist cannot open Reports
results.steps: 1. Go to /reports directly
results.expected: Access-denied message; API also returns 403
results.actual: UI: access denied; API GET /reports → HTTP 403

results.title: Accountant views collection reports
results.steps: 1. Click Reports
results.expected: Collections by day / method, revenue by procedure and dentist, CSV export
results.actual: Reports page shows collections, revenue breakdowns and CSV export

results.title: Dashboard shows clinic stats
results.steps: 1. Open Dashboard
results.expected: Today's appointments, collections, outstanding dues and low-stock counts
results.actual: Dashboard cards and charts rendered

results.title: Audit log records actions
results.steps: 1. Open Audit log
results.expected: Recent create/update/login entries with user and time
results.actual: 115 audit entries listed (latest: logins, payments, patient created)

results.title: Admin opens clinic settings
results.steps: 1. Open Settings
results.expected: Clinic name, address, tax rate and appointment defaults are editable
results.actual: Settings form with 13 editable fields
